contractProvenance.note: The operations below are official documented REST API calls. A UI-initiated XHR capture was not used or claimed.

applicationToken.persistence: Process memory only; caller supplies credentials directly and owns secure acquisition.

search.price: Each item summary's price.value is a decimal string and price.currency is the marketplace currency. Preserve it without floating-point conversion.

itemDetail.normalization: Listing description is separate from product.description; listing images are separate from product images. PRODUCT fields include product brand, GTINs, MPNs, aspect groups and additional identities when returned. categoryIdPath is split root-to-leaf while categoryPath stays a label path. Missing conditional fields remain absent. primaryItemGroup identifies a variant group and can carry group title/images but does not itself contain every option.
itemDetail.moneySemantics: Item price, auction current bid, and shipping cost stay separate. No landed or all-in total is synthesized. VAT inclusion depends on requested marketplace/context.

itemGroup.normalization: Each returned variant remains a separate REST item ID with its own price, images and localized aspects. Shared descriptions are assigned only to the exact returned itemIds named by commonDescriptions. Nonfatal server warnings are counted in the receipt without persisting their messages.

reviews.identityBoundary: An ePID-linked product rating aggregate is distinct from seller feedback and from full product review records.
reviews.fullReviewRecords: No Browse getItem product review text, reviewer metadata, photo or review-page continuation contract. Public review pages observed as HTML documents only.

affiliate.requirements: An ePN campaign ID is supplied by the publisher's own EPN account. The client sends a 10-digit campaign ID only when its caller explicitly provides one and returns only an API-provided affiliate URL whose campid matches it.
affiliate.enrollment: Unknown for this account; no campaign value is stored in this repository.

marketplaces.source: Buy API Support by Marketplace, item_summary and item rows
marketplaces.notable: Supported marketplaces do not imply production approval. The API reference notes that searchByImage is limited to US, DE, GB, and AU; this client does not implement image search.

accessBoundary.productDataKind: Marketplace listings, not wholesale supplier inventory or guaranteed dropship fulfillment.

notImplemented: full product review bodies, photos and API pagination
inventory or price change feed synchronization
shipping quote based on destination and quantity
orders, checkout, purchase, seller inventory writes, and fulfillment
